question: Swaran Singh Committee was established by the government under which Prime Minister in 1976 to make recommendations regarding fundamental duties?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indira Gandhi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Swaran Singh Committee was established in 1976 under the leadership of Prime Minister **Indira Gandhi**.
 
• The committee was tasked with making recommendations regarding the inclusion of fundamental duties in the Indian Constitution.
 
• Based on the recommendations of this committee, Part IV-A was added to the Constitution, which lists the Fundamental Duties
